policies.title: Driver eligibility
policies.summary: Review age, licence tenure, and document requirements with Singapore legal and operations teams.

policies.title: Deposits and payments
policies.summary: Demo deposits are illustrative; publish real terms only after finance/legal approval.

policies.title: Cancellation and refunds
policies.summary: Define cancellation windows, refund timing, no-show handling, and exceptions.

policies.title: Insurance and protection
policies.summary: Ensure wording matches actual policies and approved contracts.

policies.title: Cross-border travel
policies.summary: Verify vehicle, insurance, and jurisdiction rules before offering cross-border journeys.

policies.title: Privacy and retention
policies.summary: Implement reviewed privacy notice, consent, access control, and deletion policies.

faqs.question: How do I reserve a vehicle?
faqs.answer: Choose a vehicle, dates, pickup/return locations, and add-ons, then submit a demo booking request. No real reservation is created.

faqs.question: Are prices final?
faqs.answer: No. Prices are illustrative and require live quote logic, taxes, fees, deposits, and approved terms.

faqs.question: Can I rent a supercar?
faqs.answer: The catalogue includes demo supercars. Eligibility, availability, insurance, and deposits require approved operational policies.

faqs.question: Can I buy WOLF merchandise?
faqs.answer: The store contains demo products and orders; payments and fulfilment are not connected.

faqs.question: Can I select delivery?
faqs.answer: Eligible delivery hubs must be configured and verified before production launch.
